title: Coherent formal modules are closed under empty products
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf. The vertex of every limiting cone over the empty diagram in the ambient category of inverse systems of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is a coherent adic inverse system [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module].

source.place: Section 0EHN, zero-system argument written out from the definition

proof.text: An empty-diagram limit is a zero inverse system by IsLimit.isZero_pt. Mathlib IsZero.obj applied to the zero inverse system shows directly that all terms are zero. Present a zero term as the cokernel of the identity of a rank-one free module: this gives quasi-coherence and finite type, hence coherence by pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth. The ideal product is a subobject of a zero term, hence zero; the formal quotient is an epimorphic image of a zero term, hence zero. The unique isomorphism of these zero objects gives the transition condition.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModules_closedUnderEmptyProducts (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (IsCoherentFormalModule I).IsClosedUnderLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty)
